text:
ben_customer: Signed up via GitHub SSO, verified email, Apple/virtual card 3DS passed, but no free trial credits on account. Can someone check?

emily_support: Sorry about that — can you DM me the account id or paste here? quick check first: did you see the `Welcome to Redwood` email? :email:

ben_customer: I got the welcome email, account id acct_J7k2pl, payment_method pm_vcard_82, 3DS returned status `success`.

emily_support: thx. running a quick eligibility check now.

emily_support: admin check -> promo_eligibility: false, promo_block_reason: `migration_override`. Hmm. That usually comes from an import/migrations job.

emily_support: can you confirm you haven't had another prior account with the same email/linked GitHub?

ben_customer: no, brand new GH account and email. I signed up just now.

samir_payments: payments-bot logs show pm_vcard_82 3DS: success, bin_country: US, card_type: virtual. No charge attempts.

emily_support: past infra run sometimes sets `migration_override` for accounts created from SSO when we detect possible duplicate by external_id. sometimes false-positive. I'm going to attempt a manual grant but will flag growth + payments.

emily_support: running admin CLI:```
# grant free trial credits (dev/admin)
redwood-admin grants.free_trial --account acct_J7k2pl --amount 50 --reason "manual grant after false migration flag"
```

emily_support: command returned: `{"status":"queued","task_id":"tg_4829"}`

payments-bot: WARNING: account acct_J7k2pl flagged for potential duplicate email linkage in last 24h. Manual grants require approval from growth if flagged.

aditya_growth: looping in growth ops. need quick summary + was this SSO/GH create? also include whether payment method passed 3DS.

emily_support: summary: created via GitHub SSO, email verified, pm_vcard_82 3DS success, promo_eligibility false set by `migration_override` tag (likely false-positive), payments logs clear (no charges). ask: approve manual free trial grant?

aditya_growth: can we confirm user didn't have prior usage under a different email? ask support to search `external_id` and IP.

emily_support: searched external_id GH:gh_109872 -> no other accounts. IP on signup 18.205.12.224 (us-east-1). No other signups from that IP in last 7 days.

aditya_growth: OK proceed. approve manual grant. pls include note so we can follow up with infra team to fix migration job.

emily_support: thanks. re-running grant job with approval flag:```
redwood-admin grants.free_trial --account acct_J7k2pl --amount 50 --reason "approved by growth tg_4829" --force-override true
```

emily_support: job finished: `{"status":"success","credited_amount":50,"balance":50}`

emily_support: ben_customer — you should see 50 credits in the console now. can you refresh and confirm? :eyes:

ben_customer: I see them, thanks! super fast.

emily_support: great. leaving a ticket to infra: `INVEST-945` to audit migration job that set `migration_override` on SSO-created accounts when not necessary.

emily_support: notes for support docs: - when promo_eligibility=false and promo_block_reason contains `migration_override`, escalate to growth if payments-bot warns duplicate. If GH SSO + 3DS success + no external duplicates -> manual grant allowed. Add example admin command.

samir_payments: logged a payments review entry: PAY-1702. no suspicious activity, card virtual but passed 3DS and BIN checks.

aditya_growth: closing on our side. action: infra to patch migration job + add a nightly reconciliation to clear false flags for new SSO accounts that pass checks.

emily_support: thanks everyone — marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
